subject: hpc tip: killing lots of jobs

messages.author: d937725932737182
messages.subject: hpc tip: killing lots of jobs
parts:
While in your putty bash shell thingy, type:

qdel `seq -f "%.0f" 454837 455111` 

where 454837 was the first job in a sequence and 455111 is the last.

yeah, the other day I submitted over a thousand jobs when I only meant to submit 10.
